walkthrough.browse:
# Review the prepared update list

Use the Activity Bar entry to inspect the provided VS Code release snapshots before you export the briefing files.

- Confirm which versions are part of the request.
- Check the focus areas that need to appear in the exported briefings.
walkthrough.export:
# Export the requested briefings

Run the export command after reviewing the selected release notes.

- Write one Markdown file for each supported locale.
- Keep the packaging flow available so the workspace can emit a VSIX package.
walkthrough.package:
# Package the extension for distribution

Confirm the localized assets are included in the VSIX output.

- Verify the packaged extension still contains the locale-aware manifest files.
- Make sure the walkthrough and runtime assets ship together.
